summary: Useful variants reverse the roles, escalate adaptively, and add verification that is structurally independent of the model pair.

items.text: Use a cheap model to draft multiple bounded candidates and a stronger model to compare them against primary evidence and a fixed acceptance rubric.
Start with the smaller model for both planning and execution, escalating only the failing stage when calibrated uncertainty or an external check crosses a threshold.
Require executor outputs to pass tests, type checks, policy checks, or domain validators before the planning model's review can approve them.
Persist plan revisions, rejected approaches, model versions, validation results, and final rationale so later runs can learn from the actual handoff failure.
